Messages.Author: François
Messages.Body:
Hello,

Someone in my playgroup believes I cannot use a Kerrie at long range
with Pushing the Limit to inflict strength + 3 ranged damage.
I believe the contrary :)

Who is right ? :)

François

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


François is.

You can use Pushing the Limit at [POT] to make a melee weapon strike at +3
damage, including the ranged melee weapon strike of the Kerrie, which would
inflict a total of strength (the base Kerrie ranged strike damage) + 3 damage.
